title: /harness/branch/[branch]/[...at]/pages/[entity]
responsibility: Shows one page at a branch tip or a selected commit: its contract, size, performance and what proves it.

outputs.name: +page
outputs.description: The rendered page markup mounts HarnessScreen with the literal title Page and EntityVisualScreen as its content. It is the route's only markup; this file declares no inputs or additional page elements.

outputs.name: title
outputs.description: The literal string passed as the title prop to HarnessScreen. It identifies this screen and does not vary by branch, commit, or entity in this file.
